The participants of the study are eleven 16–18-year-old students of technical building service and their vocational teacher, who work at the construction site located in the college’s premises. The focus is on reading the ventilation blueprint at the work site: What kind of literacy practice is the blueprint and what kind of situated factors affect its’ use? The data consist of field observation data at the work site and interviews with the students and they were analysed using nexus anal
europe.source: Nordic Journal of Vocational Education & Training
